notes.title: Halloween in Centralia: Homecoming
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/ed8d7210022991fbe90b7c0889a5c59b72626b61.jpg[/img]
A new Halloween themed mod has been added which is available in the main menu. You play as a disembodied hand. A new location, new models, new mechanics. The main goal is to survive and find your body.

This event will run for 5 days. Afterwards the mod will be sold separately as a DLC.

notes.title: Update V 1.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/247f643e2584b40a0374b6837b8329eba54e55fd.png[/img]
Centralia Homecoming to exit early access today.
What was added in update 1.8
- You can upgrade weapons
- Achievements in steam
- 10 new items
- Cabinets are no longer empty
- Points system
- Secrets
- Additional puzzles
- An opening cell has been added to the hospital
- Chests
- Hacking system
- 15 new sounds
- 15 new models
- Gems that can be sold
- food
- Inventory changed
And much more.

notes.title: Update V 1.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/22fa350fd169813dbec97f9d65ffb742f42f9d11.gif[/img]
- High-quality animation of death, a new video alert.
- Added reload of any weapon
- Shot slope animations
- 15 new animations of the main character
- Added torso model
- Starvation in zombies, now the hungrier the zombies, the faster they move
- 3 new zombie animations
- Improved AI, now zombies patrol the terrain
- 4 new zombie audio
- Tricky artificial intelligence, now if zombies hear you: they can wait around the corner, or jump abruptly from around the corner, or when the door opens
- Fixed camera rotation
- Fixed a collision in store No. 1 near the save
- Optimization + 10%
- Added audio 2
- Also fixed code panels, intercoms and safes.

notes.title: Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928185/11a63023c384156f0e04a53630713774aa68d480.jpg[/img]
First-person horror came out in early access - Centralia: Homecoming.
Feel free to leave your comments and suggestions, we will respond to them as quickly as possible.

We decided to please you, and put a 25% discount on the game in honor of early access.

The discount will last 7 days!

Have a good game!
